svg.title: Beagle dog
svg.desc: Standing tricolor beagle with compact canine proportions, long ears, short coat, neutral tail, and uncollared stance. Biological basis: Purpose-bred dogs are used selectively in veterinary, cardiovascular, pharmacology, toxicology, and medical-device research under specialized welfare regulation.
